differences.what: Red flags, disposition and follow up are a note type of their own, added by itself with the first Medical note of a visit and completed first.
differences.why: forms 6.2; inventory A5, A55; PRD main 409

differences.what: Required: Complete waits for an answer. It goes into the EMS handoff summary, as does every answer of the EMS branch.
Choose-one, with the labels as the lines write them. UNCERTAIN opens no branch; it shows in the recap.
EMS activated? and Patient agrees to transport? show when the answer is YES.
If NO: belongs to Patient agrees to transport?: the reason shows when it is NO, labelled Reason not transported.
differences.why: inventory A19; PRD main 413 (reason if not)

differences.what: Other asks for a short text.
Time EMS called shows when EMS activated? is YES, and is required then. 10:52 AM is an example, not a default.
differences.why: forms 6.2; inventory A19; recipe (no default values)

differences.what: The handoff summary is not typed: it is built from the fields marked handoff.
COPY / SHARE HANDOFF becomes Show handoff: a full-screen page with no copy and no share, offered when EMS activated? is YES.
Choose-many. None is exclusive. Declined cannot be held with ED, EMS, ED referral or Transport arranged. The row has no Buttons: label.
differences.why: PRD main 102; inventory A4, A21 (the full list of pairs is for the clinical team)

differences.what: Choose-one. Specific date shows a date in the future.
